newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela signs Orimulsion supply deal with China.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela signs Orimulsion supply deal with China.

text.p: Venezuela's Bitumenes de Orinoco (Bitor) said Thursday it had signed a deal with Oil to supply one million tonnes of its trademark boiler fuel Orimulsion to China in 1997.

The deal "realizes the opportunity to introduce Orimulsion, an economically competitive and environmentally-friendly fuel...to one of the largest energy markets in the world," Bitor said in a release.

Orimulsion, dubbed the world's filthiest fuel by environmentalists, would be used for continued tests on the fuel with an eye to constructing a production and emulsification unit and signing a long term supply contract, Bitor said.
The deal was signed in Beijing by Bitor President Carlos Borregales, China Oil President Lin Qingshan and Guo Ao President Wu Guo Zhi, the Bitor release said.
Venezuela exported about four million tonnes of the fuel in 1996 to countries including Japan, Great Britain and Canada.
